propositions: review_interrupts metric is published dimensionless and cannot distinguish bound-exceeded from signal-unavailable, forcing operators to shell into hosts for diagnosis
autodeploy.sh already stamps the reason field in AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT markers but observability.sh throws it away when counting
signal-unavailable (probe broken, deploys blind) and bound-exceeded (bot busy, drain working) require opposite remediations but are indistinguishable in alarms
observability.sh must split journal patterns into three separate metrics (bound-exceeded, signal-unavailable, and unchanged rolled-up total) via new offset files and existing helper
monitoring_autodeploy.tf must replace the single review_interrupts alarm with two reason-scoped alarms, each with only its own remediation, leaving rolled-up metric unpublished
terraform apply must be executed in infra/terraform to make the alarm changes live on the account
